summary: netapp.ontap 14.3.0 added AWS Lambda support to many modules including EMS, fpolicy, kerberos, security SSH, unix users/groups, user roles and vscan modules.
questions: Do netapp.ontap vscan modules support AWS Lambda?
Can na_ontap_user run through AWS Lambda?

answer_card.title: netapp.ontap Lambda support (14.3.0)
answer_card.answer_md: AWS Lambda support added to: `na_ontap_cg_snapshot`, `na_ontap_cli_timeout`, EMS (`ems_config`, `ems_destination`, `ems_filter`), file security (`fdsd`, `fdsp`, `fdspt`, `fdss`, `file_security_permissions_acl`), fpolicy (`event`, `ext_engine`, `policy`, `scope`, `status`), Kerberos (`interface`, `realm`), `login_messages`, `nvme_namespace`, `publickey`, `rest_cli`, `security_key_manager`, `security_ssh`, `snaplock_clock`, `unix_group`, `unix_user`, `user`, `user_role`, vscan modules, and `vserver_audit`.
